senses.gloss: लय् (cf. √ रय्) cl. 1. Ā. लयते, to go, Dhātup. xiv, 10 (Vop.)
लय , लयन &c. See p. 903, col. 2.
लय m. the act of sticking or clinging to (loc.), Śiś. (लयं √ गा with loc., ‘to become attached to any one’, Kuval.)
lying down, cowering, MBh.
melting, dissolution, disappearance or absorption in (loc. or comp.), Up.; Kap. &c. (लयं √ गम् or या ‘to disappear, be dissolved or absorbed’; लयं सं-√ गम्, ‘to hide or conceal one's self’)
extinction, destruction, death, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (लयं √ या, ‘to be destroyed, perish’)
rest, repose, Śiś.; BhP. (cf. अ-लय)
place of rest, residence, house, dwelling, W.
mental inactivity, spiritual indifference, Kap.; Vedāntas.
sport, diversion, merriness, Vās.
delight in anything, Harav.
an embrace, L.
(in music) time (regarded as of 3 kinds, viz. द्रुत, ‘quick’, मध्य, ‘mean or moderate’, and विलम्बित, ‘slow’), Kālid.; Daśar.; Pañcat. &c.
a kind of measure, Saṃgīt.
the union of song, dance and instrumental music, L.
a pause, MW.
a partic. agricultural implement (perhaps a sort of harrow or hoe), VS.
a swoon, L.
the quick (downward) movement of an arrow, L.
लय n. the root of Andropogon Muricatus, Bhpr.
लय mfn. making the mind inactive or indifferent, BhP.
लाय m. (perhaps fr. √ लि = री, to set in motion, throw) a missile, weapon, RV. x, 42, 1 (accord. to Sāy. = संश्लेषण, हृदय-वेधिन्).
लया f. N. of a Yoginī, Hcat. (v.l. जया)
लय—काल m. time of dissolution or destruction, MW.
लय—गत mfn. gone to dissolution, dissolved, melted, ib.
लय—नालिक m. a Buddhist or Jaina temple, L.
लय—पुत्री f. ‘daughter of (musical) time’, a female dancer, actress, L.
लय—मध्य mfn. to be performed in mean or moderate time (as a piece of music), Mālav.
लय—योग m. N. of wk.
लय—शुद्ध mfn. to be performed in clear or right time (cf. लय above), Śak.
लय—स्थान n. place of dissolution, Vedāntas.
लयारम्भ or लयालम्ब, m. ‘moving according to time’, a dancer, actor, L.
लयारम्भ or लयालम्ब, m. ‘moving according to time’, a dancer, actor, L.
लयार्क m. the sun at the dissolution of the world, BhP.
लयालय m. du. destruction and non-destruction, R.
लयन n. the act of clinging, adhering, lying &c., rest, repose, Śiś., Sch.
a place of rest, house, cell &c., Śiś.; Prab.; Kāraṇḍ.
लायक mfn. clinging, sticking, adhering &c., APrāt., Sch.
